title: feat(foundry): APK cross-reference toolkit — acquire/extract/classify/xref utility belt
body:
[MUSEai]@{role:{reverse-engineering-toolkits}} Owner order via Foundry lane (a27e8da6): dedicated RE toolkits lane, first belt = APK<->repo cross-reference for the 30-app wave (#2063-#2123, -apk briefs #2064-#2123).

- ops/web_adapter_foundry/apk_xref.py (stdlib-only): (1) acquire from GitHub Releases / Gitea Releases / F-Droid metadata with provenance (source, version, build, sha256); Play refused as a source; no-APK yields a no-artifact-found evidence record, never a substitute build. (2) extract: built-in binary AXML parser (package, version, permissions, components, deep links) + DEX string tables -> endpoints/hosts actually embedded, provider configs (ids + key NAMES only, values never extracted; config files excluded from corpus), tracker signatures, feature signals (llama.cpp/GGUF/ONNX/TFLite/...). (3) scan-repo drafts apk-claims/v1 from the paired source tree; claims engine gives deterministic supported/contradicted/not-found for the briefs' particular checks (relagent #2123 pure-local vs network behaviour; llama.cpp/Gemma bundling) and honest unchecked otherwise. (4) cross_validate diffs BOTH directions (hosts/endpoints/providers/permissions/features/package/trackers/signals) -> verdict match|divergences-found|no-artifact-found.
- Classification: apk_signatures.json (providers/trackers/feature signals) -> deterministic class/provider/tracker/signal/permission tags + routes, so wave findings tag consistently.
- SEAM with PR #2140 (research-triggers, merged): report JSON is the apk-xref/v1 findings record with the form's exact keys; markdown findings use the form headings verbatim — verified firsthand: a generated findings file fed through scripts/apk_xref/apk_xref_intake.py re-parses losslessly, every findings field identical. Recorded divergence: form enum labels google-play, belt acquisition still refuses Play scraping.
- Tests: tests/test_apk_xref.py 10/10 (synthetic APK built in-test: AXML+DEX builders; secret-value leak test caught + fixed a corpus leak from google-services.json). Existing suites green alongside (37 total with intake + foundry).
- LIVE PROOF (remote, this lane): acquire f-droid org.fdroid.fdroid -> 2.0.2 build 2000052, 12,569,951 B, sha256 19d51fad4822; extract -> 31 permissions, 36 components, 3 DEX, 69 hosts, 339 endpoints (a generic 'segment' marker false-positive was found + tightened during the proof).
- docs/ops/APK-XREF-TOOLKIT.md + README section + example claims file. No templates built here (research-triggers owns them); Foundry migrates the 30 briefs onto the set.
